blurb: Marina Del Ray has over 500 boat slips ranging from 20 to 60 feet, with some T-docks accommodating boats up to 100 feet. They offer covered slips, dry storage for trailered boats, and transient slips billed at $2 per foot. The marina maintains two boat launches with a small fee and provides access to bathrooms, showers, and laundry facilities for tenants.
extraNote: Slip rates based on price per foot, per month; call or email for current rates · Slip availability on a first-come, first-served basis
